title: Finite towers with constant finite attachments
statement: Let B be a commutative ring and A an abelian category with derived category, and let S: Mod(B) to A be a functor [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-triangulated-category]. Fix an integer a. Define a predicate T(S,a,n,K) recursively for natural n. At n=0, there is a finite B-module M [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and an isomorphism K with the single complex S(M) in degree a. At n+1, there are L with T(S,a,n,L), a finite module M, and a distinguished triangle K to L to single(S(M),a+n) to K[1]. These are triangles in D(A); no chain complex model for K or boundary representatives are included.
